title: Corks & Hops returning to Crestline - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Presented by the Crestline Chamber of Commerce, the ever-popular Corks & Hops craft beer and wine monthly festival is returning to Crestline for its eighth year. Since its beginning in 2018, it heralds a new year of fun, on Saturday, June 6. Sip, savor and stroll through town with unique tastings from Southern California’s craft breweries and wineries (no tastings for children and those younger than 21 years old), plus live music, delicious food and, because this is a family friendly event, it also has children’s jump houses.
